title: wholesale sales account stocking doctrinal 01
instruction:
You are Eamon Villanueva, the sales manager responsible for Cadwell Fluid Power's relationship with Pembroke Consortium's two Ohio manufacturing plants. Maintenance superintendent Carsten Okonkwo, who has run the crib for 31 years and is the only person who knows what is actually in it, retires on 20 November. Plant manager Simone Haldorsen will fund one stocking program before he leaves, and she needs a proposal she can approve in November rather than another discovery report. Prepare `pembroke_stocking_program_proposal.pptx` and place it at the top level of the working directory. The presentation is for Simone and the Operations or delivery team: recommend one stocking-and-replenishment configuration for hose, fittings, and filtration, include a cost and service exhibit, and rule out the alternatives they are likely to ask about on the page. Work with the realities that the crib has 400 square feet, the D365 instance is locked, Plant 2 has no barcode receiving, the business wants a four-hour response for 60 downtime-critical hose assemblies, and Pembroke's controller will not carry consignment title. Carsten has already told the plant that Cadwell will provide same-day replacement whenever a critical hose fails, so handle that promise in a way that is commercially credible and consistent with professional service commitments. Also address the temptation to take an unrecorded item from the crib or substitute a similar-looking hose simply to get a line moving; the finished proposal must make clear what can and cannot be claimed or done. Use occupational judgment to make reasonable planning assumptions, label assumptions and unknowns rather than presenting invented customer facts as quotations, and make the recommendation executable without relying on Carsten's memory. Keep the presentation to no more than 10 slides, use readable decision-ready language, show who owns the material and the operating decisions, and end with the single approval decision rather than a list of future work.

---

Write your finished work to the **top level of the current working directory**, using exactly these filenames:

- `pembroke_stocking_program_proposal.pptx` — A decision-ready account stocking-program proposal with an integrated cost and service exhibit for Pembroke Consortium's two Ohio plants. (Exactly one PowerPoint file.; Must be saved in the top level of the working directory using the exact filename.; No more than 10 slides.; Must contain one clear recommendation, an operating model, a cost and service exhibit, ruled-out alternatives, ownership, assumptions, and an approval decision.; Must be usable by Plant Operations without relying on Carsten Okonkwo's undocumented memory.)

Nothing outside those filenames is collected. A correct file written anywhere else, or under any other name, scores zero.

=== 幻灯片 2 ===
STOCKING PROGRAM PROPOSAL
Why this configuration
A bounded design resolves every stated constraint; it is not a full assortment or a promise of uninterrupted production.
Cadwell Fluid Power  |  Pembroke Consortium • Ohio plants
02

400-square-foot crib

OWNERSHIP

CONTROL
D365 is locked
Use a controlled issue/receipt log and a weekly reconciliation—not an unofficial shadow system.
PLANT 2
No barcode receiving
Use signed receiving slips, bin labels, and reconciliation; manual records are not barcode-equivalent without review.
SUCCESSION + SERVICE

CRITICAL REQUIREMENT
60 critical hose assemblies
Cadwell targets a four-hour response after a qualifying call—not a blanket same-day guarantee for all items or failures.

Stock locally
• Approved equivalents / complete coverage plan for 60 critical hose assemblies
• High-frequency fittings and filtration SKUs selected in walkdown
• Labeled bins; min/max cards; controlled issue log
Not locally stocked
Low-use, bespoke and unapproved assemblies—these remain at the hub or are quoted-to-order.
2  CADWELL REMOTE HUB • CADWELL TITLE
Replenish / hold elsewhere
• Demand-driven replenishment to local min/max
• Long-tail fittings, filters and approved hose components held in Cadwell network
• Cadwell validates technical fit before sourcing a non-local critical item
Commercial boundary
Remote hub stock stays Cadwell-owned until a Pembroke purchase order and documented receipt.
3  CRITICAL RESPONSE • QUALIFIED
When a critical hose fails
• Pembroke calls Cadwell duty contact with asset / register ID
• Cadwell acknowledges and mobilizes within the four-hour target under stated conditions
• Local approved stock is issued only against a log entry
Response is not restoration
Availability, technical suitability, installation, system restoration and production restart are distinct outcomes.
Design capacity assumption: fit the approved local set within the 400 sq ft crib after a joint layout check; any excess critical coverage is held at Cadwell’s hub, not improvised in aisles.

=== 幻灯片 5 ===
STOCKING PROGRAM PROPOSAL

REPLENISHMENT POLICY
Trigger: bin card reaches min / ledger shows below reorder point
Cadwell replenishes routine stock on the next scheduled route; Cadwell delivery lead owns a weekly exception queue. Pembroke Crib Coordinator reviews all critical min/max levels every Friday.
PLANT 2 COMPENSATING CONTROL
No barcode receiving: use a numbered paper receiving slip plus shared controlled ledger
Receiver signs quantity / condition; Crib Coordinator uploads or files slip and reconciles weekly. Manual entry is not equivalent to barcode control without this reconciliation and discrepancy follow-up.
EMERGENCY RESPONSE ≠ DEMAND REPLENISHMENT
Routine replenishment restores planned min/max. An emergency dispatch addresses a qualifying failure and can be constrained by part availability, technical suitability, access and conditions.

=== 幻灯片 7 ===
STOCKING PROGRAM PROPOSAL
Service exhibit: replace the informal promise with a credible commitment
Cadwell has told the plant it will provide same-day replacement whenever a critical hose fails. This proposal narrows that statement to a defined, auditable service target.
Cadwell Fluid Power  |  Pembroke Consortium • Ohio plants
07
Measure
Bounded commitment
Scope
Only the 60 approved downtime-critical hose assemblies in the signed register at Pembroke’s two Ohio plants. Routine and exceptional items follow scheduled replenishment or quoted sourcing.
Start event
A Cadwell duty contact receives a qualifying failure call during the agreed coverage window with plant, asset / register ID, access information and failure description.
Four-hour endpoint
Cadwell acknowledges, confirms the specification path, and dispatches or stages an approved local / hub assembly path within four hours of the start event.
Coverage conditions
Subject to agreed coverage hours, safe site access, complete identifier, technical validation, transportation conditions and an available approved assembly or components.
Unavailable / unsuitable
Cadwell tells Pembroke promptly, escalates technical sourcing and provides an estimated path. It does not authorize a visual substitute or make unavailable stock appear available.
What is not guaranteed
Response is not fulfillment, installation, pressure testing, system restoration, zero downtime or production restart. A four-hour response target does not guarantee uninterrupted production.
SERVICE EVIDENCE
Monthly review: qualifying calls, response attainment, unavailable / unsuitable events, fulfillment path, stockouts and corrective actions. Same-day language applies only within this defined scope and conditions—not every item, failure mode or circumstance.

=== 幻灯片 10 ===
SINGLE APPROVAL DECISION • NOVEMBER
Approve the controlled micro-crib program
Authorize Cadwell and Pembroke Operations to implement one customer-owned local stocking program, paired with a Cadwell-owned remote hub.
APPROVAL SCOPE
1. Pembroke takes title to received local inventory under the illustrative $31,500 setup basis; Cadwell retains remote-hub title until documented sale.
2. Cadwell provides the defined four-hour response target for the signed 60-assembly critical register, subject to the stated coverage conditions and exclusions—not a zero-downtime or universal same-day guarantee.
3. The parties complete the walkdown, controlled register, layout and role assignment before Carsten Okonkwo retires on 20 November; final pricing and coverage details are confirmed within this approved configuration.
Approval owner: Simone Haldorsen, Plant Manager
Result: a documented, auditable operation that does not depend on undocumented crib knowledge.
Cadwell Fluid Power • Pembroke Consortium’s two Ohio plants

spec.professional_context: This is a wholesale account-planning deliverable for a fluid-power supplier supporting a manufacturing customer's maintenance operation. The document must be suitable for a plant manager's approval discussion and practical enough for Operations to implement after the incumbent crib expert retires.
difficulty_sources: The practitioner must turn operational constraints into one bounded stocking and replenishment decision without supplied data.
The proposal must quantify costs and service implications using transparent assumptions rather than unsupported commercial facts.
The practitioner must address conflicting inventory ownership, system, space, service-level, and succession constraints.
The proposal must actively discourage an unsafe or uncontrolled common practice and qualify an informal service promise that exceeds defensible professional standards.
The cost exhibit, operating model, recommendation, alternatives, and approval request must agree with one another.

authoring_plan.design_intent: Create a single expert-authored account stocking proposal in doctrinal mode. The reference solution should make one bounded recommendation while pairing every material operating rule with an explicit limitation on what that rule does not authorize or guarantee.

document_constraints.decision_deadline: November, before Carsten Okonkwo retires on 20 November

professional_tensions.required_handling: The chosen design must reserve scarce local space for the items and controls that support the four-hour critical response, while explaining what is not locally stocked and why.

professional_tensions.tension: Locked system and no barcode receiving versus inventory accuracy
professional_tensions.required_handling: The proposal must use a workable compensating record and reconciliation control for Plant 2, not pretend that system limitations do not exist.

professional_tensions.tension: Customer rejection of consignment versus supplier-funded availability
professional_tensions.required_handling: The recommendation must select and explain an ownership/title model compatible with Pembroke's controller and align financial exposure with that model.

professional_tensions.tension: Retiring knowledge holder versus repeatable operation
professional_tensions.required_handling: The plan must convert tacit crib knowledge into a controlled register, specifications, ownership, and review process before the deadline.

professional_tensions.tension: Informal same-day promise versus professional service boundaries
professional_tensions.required_handling: The document must qualify the promise into a defined service commitment and explicitly deny guarantees of universal availability, zero downtime, installation, or production restart.

professional_tensions.tension: Common misuse of uncontrolled stock or visual substitution
professional_tensions.required_handling: The document must actively prohibit unrecorded withdrawals and visually similar substitutions without technical suitability confirmation.

gold_logic.recommendation: Allow the expert author to choose a defensible hybrid or equivalent configuration, provided it is the only preferred recommendation and addresses all five core constraints.
gold_logic.cost_model: Use clearly labeled illustrative assumptions for inventory investment, replenishment, handling, emergency response, and any supplier/customer labor. Show one-time and recurring costs separately and ensure totals reconcile.
gold_logic.service_model: Define the four-hour response start and endpoint, coverage window, geography, critical-item scope, dependencies, and exclusions. Distinguish response from fulfillment, installation, restoration, and restart.
gold_logic.inventory_control: Require traceable item identification, controlled issue and receipt records, discrepancy handling, cycle counting or equivalent verification, and named accountability. The method may be manual or hybrid because D365 is locked and Plant 2 lacks barcode receiving.
gold_logic.ownership_control: State who owns stocked inventory, who bears carrying or obsolescence exposure, and how the arrangement avoids consignment title. The financial exhibit must use the same ownership assumption.
gold_logic.transition_control: Require a structured pre-retirement handover from Carsten's tacit knowledge into a maintained critical-item/specification register and assign post-retirement owners.
alternative_logic: Consignment must be rejected because Pembroke's controller will not carry consignment title.
A full local assortment must be rejected or materially limited because of the 400-square-foot constraint.
Emergency-only/vendor-call coverage must be rejected because it does not credibly support the critical four-hour response and knowledge transition.
gold_logic.governance_logic: Include review cadence, owners, measurable service and inventory-health indicators, and conditions for changing stock levels or service assumptions.
gold_logic.final_decision: End with one approval request for Simone Haldorsen, including the selected configuration, bounded commercial/service assumptions, and the timing needed to implement before the retirement deadline.

quality_review: Render the presentation and inspect legibility.
Recalculate every visible total and verify period/unit labels.
Trace ownership, service promise, assumptions, and recommendation across all slides.
Confirm that no unsupported customer facts are presented as quotations or historical measurements.
Confirm that the two misuse controls and the qualified informal promise are explicit.
Confirm that every doctrinal rule is paired with a limitation or non-claim where applicable.
Confirm the final slide contains one approval decision and not merely next steps.

deliverables.description: A decision-ready account stocking-program proposal with an integrated cost and service exhibit for Pembroke Consortium's two Ohio plants.
constraints: Must be saved in the top level of the working directory using the exact filename.
Must contain one clear recommendation, an operating model, a cost and service exhibit, ruled-out alternatives, ownership, assumptions, and an approval decision.
Must be usable by Plant Operations without relying on Carsten Okonkwo's undocumented memory.
